title: Reversal of Adjudicated TRICARE Prime Claim Lines
content:
A reversal of a **TRICARE Prime** claim line withdraws exactly the cost share and point-of-service deductible of one adjudicated line, identified by that line's own record.

## Clauses

1. A reversal is posted only for these reasons: an overturned appeal, a duplicate claim, other health insurance found retroactively, a provider correction, or reprocessing after the catastrophic cap was reached.
2. A line is reversed at most once. **Condition:** the line being reversed has not already been reversed, as the claim-line records show for that line.
3. A corrected line, when needed, is posted as a new claim line.

## Cases

| Situation of the line | Reversal |
|---|---|
| Adjudicated, never reversed, reason among those listed | posted; withdraws the line's cost share and deductible exactly |
| Already reversed once | not posted |
| A correction is needed after the reversal | the correction is a new claim line, not a second reversal |

**Hypothetical figures.** A line that carried a 300.00 cost share, 200.00 of it applied to the point-of-service deductible, is reversed for a duplicate claim: the reversal withdraws 300.00 of cost share and 200.00 of deductible.
